availability_rules.industry_membership: in_date <= observation date and out_date is empty or out_date > observation date
availability_rules.financial_record: initial disclosure only; ann_date <= observation date
availability_rules.target_maturity: future 60-session industry return must end by 20231231

signal: equal-weight mean of constituent positive net-profit YoY, revenue YoY, operating-cash-flow YoY and ROE shares
sampling: last available trading day of each month
primary_target: next 60 trading-session Shenwan level-1 industry return
selection_2024_2025_open_rule: Only after the information gate and a separately registered development strategy gate pass.
failure_rule: If any information gate fails, do not build or replay a strategy candidate and do not tune signal weights, age or horizon.
